assumptions: DUST, SEG and WindowMasker as BLAST+ implements them, at the levels given.
limits: Masks low-complexity and over-represented sequence; it does not identify what the sequence is.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A transform: the sequence with the named spans masked, with nothing inferred; the Contamination panel's reading is on the screen that found them.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which stretches of this sequence should a similarity search not seed on?

description: Mask the parts of a sequence a similarity search should not seed on, using BLAST's own three maskers: DUST for compositionally biased DNA (poly-A, simple repeats), SEG for the protein equivalent, and WindowMasker for repeats that are ordinary in composition but occur far more often than chance allows in the sequences given. Emits the soft- and hard-masked sequences and the masked intervals, so a pipeline can mask before it searches rather than explaining an empty hit table afterwards.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

context.description: WindowMasker only: the other sequences whose statistics define 'over-represented'. Its thresholds come from this SET, so wiring one plasmid asks whether a stretch is unusual for that plasmid, not for the organism. Only applies when masker is windowmasker.

hicut.description: SEG's K2, the extension complexity in bits. Only applies when masker is seg.

level.description: DUST's T. Higher masks less. Only applies when masker is dust.

locut.description: SEG's K1, the trigger complexity in bits. Only applies when masker is seg.

masker.description: which masker. dust and windowmasker take DNA; seg takes protein. Values: dust (DUST · biased DNA composition), seg (SEG · biased protein composition), windowmasker (WindowMasker · over-represented DNA).

sequence.description: the sequence to mask. Wire a record or a sequence output, or paste it. Left empty, the open record is used.

unit_size.description: WindowMasker's n-mer length. 0 derives it from the length of everything given, the way the tool does. Only applies when masker is windowmasker.

window.description: the scored window's width. 0 takes each masker's own default.

name: mask_sequence

hardMasked.description: the sequence with the masked stretches replaced by N (or X for a protein)

masked.description: the sequence soft-masked (lower case), which is what BLAST reads as masked

maskedFraction.description: what share of the sequence was masked, 0 to 1. Wire into a $when to refuse a query that is mostly gone

provenance.description: the masker, the parameters it really used, and for WindowMasker the derived thresholds and the set they came from
